    marker_cols = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] not in (background, line) for r in range(h))]
    out = []
    for r1, r2 in zip(marker_rows, marker_rows[1:]):
        row = []
        for c1, c2 in zip(marker_cols, marker_cols[1:]):
            corners = [grid[r1][c1], grid[r1][c2], grid[r2][c1], grid[r2][c2]]
            if corners[0] not in (background, line) and all(x == corners[0] for x in corners):
                row.append(corners[0])
